Overview

Pelotas is a city in RS with a population of 343,132. Southern Rio Grande do Sul’s cultural capital, known for its historic confectionery tradition, neoclassical architecture, and university life. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
